name: revxl-os-superengine
description: Autonomous coaching ops superengine for Claude Code. Task agent collects commitments from email, calendar, transcripts, and DMs into a single canonical store, drafts a morning brief, syncs to your existing task system (GHL/ClickUp/Airtable), and lets you add tasks by texting a Telegram channel. Plus a DM-triage agent and a general orchestrator. Built on Claude Code Channels, Telegram supergroup topics, and stealth browser automation — the OpenClaw alternative that doesn't break on every update.
